rules.id: sha256 of the sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON of {name, inputs: {info, text}}
rules.text: inputs.text names bytes in this file's blobs by sha256; each leg reads them decoded as UTF-8 with CRLF and a lone CR read as LF, except reading, which is handed the bytes
